themes.name: Vault Classic
themes.tagline: The house style. Navy steel, brass rivets and the combination dial that guards every pull.
themes.unlockText: Unlocked by default for every new collector.
themes.motif: Riveted steel plate with rings radiating from the dial.

openingEffect.summary: The dial spins one full turn and clicks before the wrapper splits.
openingEffect.spec: Combination dial on the wrapper rotates 360deg (~600ms, ease-out), plays a click, then the wrapper splits along the top crimp.

themes.name: Ember Forge
themes.tagline: Molten orange on blackened iron, with heat rising off every seam.
themes.motif: Rising heat chevrons with embers drifting up from the dial.

openingEffect.summary: Sparks burst from the tear line and card edges glow orange as they flip.
openingEffect.spec: Orange spark particles burst from the tear line; each card's edge gets a short orange glow as it flips.

themes.name: Tidal Depths
themes.tagline: Deep teal water with ripples spreading outward from the dial.
themes.motif: Concentric ripples layered over a rolling wave print.

openingEffect.summary: The wrapper dissolves into a ripple and cards surface one by one.
openingEffect.spec: Wrapper fades/dissolves outward as an expanding ripple ring from the dial; cards rise in one at a time with a slight vertical float.

themes.name: Verdant Grove
themes.tagline: Forest green and parchment, overgrown with a tiled leaf print.
themes.motif: Angled leaf tiles with a parchment-edged dial.

openingEffect.summary: Vines peel the wrapper open from the corners and leaves drift past the reveal.
openingEffect.spec: Wrapper peels from the four corners (vine/leaf motion); a few leaf particles drift across the reveal.

themes.name: Storm Circuit
themes.tagline: Charged yellow traces on graphite, crackling with blue sparks.
themes.motif: Circuit-board traces feeding into the dial, with a lightning bolt on the wrapper.

openingEffect.summary: A bolt cracks across the pack and the screen flashes white on a rare pull.
openingEffect.spec: A lightning bolt flash crosses the pack on open; a brief white screen flash plays only when a rare or better is revealed.

themes.name: Eclipse Prism
themes.tagline: The secret skin. A midnight field, a crescent eclipse and a holo prism rim.
themes.motif: Starfield and crescent eclipse behind the dial, framed by a prism rim.

openingEffect.summary: The pack goes dark, then the rim catches light and sweeps holo across every card.
openingEffect.spec: Screen dims, the prism rim lights up, and a holographic sheen sweeps across each card as it is revealed.
